fee_notes: Two royalty tiers: Learning Center 8.0% of Net Sales; Studio Center 12.0% of Net Sales. Marketing Contribution is 2.25% of Net Sales contributed to the Brand Marketing Development Fund; local marketing spend obligation also applies (see Item 11). Technology Fee is currently $350/month; franchisor may increase annually by up to 10% (with any unused increases carried forward). Pre-opening minimum royalty of $500/month applies if franchisee misses opening deadline.
raw_excerpt:
Learning Center Royalty Fee (Note 1) | 8.0% of Net Sales (Note 2) | At the time of the transaction (Note 3) |
Studio Center Royalty Fee (Note 1) | 12.0% of Net Sales (Note 2) | At the time of the transaction (Note 3) |
Marketing Contribution (Note 1) | 2.25% of Net Sales | Same as royalties | Marketing Contributions are contributed to the Brand Marketing Development Fund, as described in Item 11. Also see Item 11 for your local marketing spend obligation.
Technology Fee (Note 1) | Our then-current fee; Currently $350/ month | Monthly (Note 3) | The Technology Fee covers the administrative costs of the technology services and licenses we provide to you. We have the right to increase the Technology Fee annually by 10% and/or change the method of payment by providing notice to you. Any increase not taken in any year may be added to increases in later years. You will pay additional fees to third party technology vendors.
Supplier/Vendor or Supplies Approval (Note 4) | Cost of inspection of supplier's facilities and/or test of supplier's samples, plus our reasonable related expenses | On demand | Only due if you propose a new supplier or vendor (or particular suppliers) that we have not previously approved.
Product and Equipment Purchases | Will vary | On delivery or as agreed | We charge you for products and equipment you purchase from or through us.
